together.tooLongLine.text: That's too long for one line. Make it shorter.

together.tooMany.text: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

together.unsafeSomeone.text: Someone's part has something {product} can't publish safely. Ask everyone to look at their part and agree again.

together.unsafeWords.text: {name}'s part has something {product} can't publish safely. Ask them to look at it and agree again.

together.waitingPublish.text: Everyone agreed. Waiting for {name} to publish it.

together.waitingPublishAnyone.text: Everyone agreed. Waiting for whoever is in charge to publish it.

together.whenRead.text: When you read each other's parts

together.whenReadShort.text: When you read each other's parts

together.yourNameHelp.text: How your part is signed when it's published.

trip.areaAddress.text: “{area}” looks like a street address. Use an area name instead, like a park or a mountain range.

trip.areaField.text: Just an area's name, not a street address or a house number.

trip.exactRoute.text: Readers can see exactly where you started and finished. Make sure it doesn't show a home, a campsite, or a place where rare plants or animals live.

trip.noArea.text: Add where you went, as an area that's safe to share, like a park or a mountain range.

trip.noConditions.text: Add the conditions: weather, trail, water, what you saw.

trip.noDistance.text: Add your route, or fill in the distance, so readers know how far you went.

undo.askHelp.text: There's a new {one} with that name now. Ask {helper} to help bring this one back.

undo.mayFind.text: “{title}” can't come back from here. {helper} may still find it.

visitors.detailsRange.text: from {from} to {to}, views {views}, visits {visits}, all time {allTime}, first day {first}, kept {kept}, series {series}

visitors.emptyText.text: When people read {product}, the numbers show up here a day or so later.

visitors.how1.text: {product} counts without cookies and keeps nothing that could tell who a reader is.

visitors.how2.text: A person reading the same page twice in a day is one visit. Nothing links one day to the next, so {product} can't tell how many different people came.

visitors.how3.text: Readers who ask not to be counted aren't counted.

visitors.how4.text: Search engines and AI tools also read your pages. They're not in these numbers.

visitors.how5.text: This counts what reaches your blog's own computer; if your blog is served from somewhere else, some visits may be missing.

visitors.keptFor.text: {product} keeps numbers for {n} days, so the start of this period isn't here.

visitors.noSignal.text: {product} can't reach your site right now, so there are no numbers to show. Try again when you have a signal.

visitors.readNone.text: No posts yet; the visits were to other pages.

visitors.serviceDown.text: Your visitor numbers aren't answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.

visitors.visitMeans.text: A visit is one person reading one page on one day.

voice.announceDone.text: Your rough draft is saved as you wrote it.

voice.announceTimeUp.text: Time's up. Your rough draft is saved as you wrote it.

voice.cantPolish.text: This rough draft can't be read, so it can't be polished.

voice.checkGone.text: The piece this quotes is gone, so it couldn't be checked. It's kept.

voice.checkMoved.text: These words aren't in that piece any more. It's kept; check it.

voice.chooseHeading.text: What would you like to write about?

voice.chooseHelp.text: You get three minutes. Nothing gets corrected, and it never appears on {product}.

voice.chooseHelpTime.text: You get {minutes} minutes. Nothing gets corrected, and it never appears on {product}.

voice.cli.text: In a terminal: openblog voice --list shows the same; openblog voice export copies the portable ones.

voice.conflictGone.text: It was thrown away or replaced somewhere else. Yours is still here.

voice.conflictHeading.text: This copy was changed somewhere else

voice.conflictText.text: Yours has {mine} words; the saved one has {theirs}. Nothing is lost: yours is still here.

voice.detailsFiles.text: Each file: where it is kept, its size and its revision

voice.discarded.text: Your last piece ran out of time with nothing written, so nothing was kept.

voice.emptyText.text: A piece is a few minutes of your own writing, on a prompt you choose. It shows your writing helper how you sound, and it never appears on {product}.

voice.eraseCopies.text: Copies kept on this phone go too. Copies in backups aren't touched; {helper} can remove those.

voice.erasePartial.text: Most of it is erased, but some files are still there.

voice.eraseText.text: This erases {what} from {product}'s computer. It can't be undone.

voice.erased.text: Erased. Checked again: nothing is left.

voice.finishingText.text: Another window is still saving its last words. This checks again in a moment.

voice.guideBroken.text: Your voice guide can't be read.

voice.guideCantNow.text: Your helper can't make a voice guide right now.

voice.guideChanged.text: Your voice guide was changed somewhere else. Make it again to compare with the new one.

voice.guideEditWait.text: Read-only until every change is chosen.

voice.guideFreeKept.text: Your own words outside these lines stay where they are.

voice.guideFromHelp.text: Up to 8 pieces at a time. Rough drafts show best how you really write.

voice.guideGoesGuide.text: Your voice guide as it is now

voice.guideGoesNot.text: Not your posts, photos, or anything about your readers. {company}'s own rules cover what it keeps.

voice.guideGoesPieces.text: The pieces you ticked, about {count} words

voice.guideHas.text: Made from your pieces. Your writing helper uses it when you turn on Sound like me.

voice.guideHelperOff.text: Your writing helper isn't turned on, so it can't make a voice guide yet.

voice.guideLeaveAsk.text: Leave without saving your voice guide?

voice.guideLeaveText.text: What your helper noticed isn't kept anywhere.

voice.guideLede.text: Your helper reads the pieces you tick and writes down how you sound, quoting your own words. Nothing is saved until you say so.

voice.guideNeedsPieces.text: Write a piece or two first. Then your helper can make a voice guide from them.

voice.guideNone.text: Your writing helper can read your pieces and write down how you sound, quoting your own words.

voice.guideNotSaved.text: Your voice guide wasn't saved. Try again in a moment.

voice.guideNothingNew.text: Your helper found nothing new to add.

voice.guideNow.text: Your guide as it is now

voice.guideNowFailed.text: Your guide couldn't be shown just now.

voice.guideOneSample.text: Lines that rest on one piece: {list}

voice.guideOver.text: That's more than your helper reads at once. Untick a few.

voice.guidePending.text: Choose for each change before saving ({n} left).

voice.guidePortableBlocked.text: It quotes private pieces, so it can only be kept private.

voice.guideProvenance.text: Keep the openblog:voice-provenance line if you edit it; the portable rule relies on it.

voice.guideResultNote.text: Each line quotes your own words. Nothing is saved until you press Save. Your helper can be wrong.

voice.guideUndone.text: Your voice guide is back as it was.

voice.guideWhereNone.text: No guide is saved yet; a new one is kept private.

voice.guideWorking.text: Reading your pieces… This can take a minute.

voice.inProgress.text: You have a piece in progress: “{title}”, {time} left.

voice.inProgressDone.text: Time ran out on “{title}”. Your rough draft is waiting.

voice.keptPhone.text: Waiting for a signal. Your writing is kept on this phone.

voice.leavePolishText.text: You changed it and didn't save. A copy stays on this phone.

voice.leaveText.text: The clock keeps going. Come back within {time} to keep writing; after that, your rough draft is saved as it is.

voice.lede.text: Write for three minutes about a prompt, the way you'd say it out loud. Your writing helper learns how you sound from these pieces. They never appear on {product}.

voice.lockFailedMemory.text: Your rough draft couldn't be saved just now, and this phone won't keep a copy. Keep this page open until you have a signal.

voice.lockFailedPhone.text: Your rough draft couldn't be saved just now. Your latest words are kept on this phone; open this page again when you have a signal.

voice.lockFailedSent.text: Your rough draft couldn't be saved just now, but your words reached {product}. Open this page again when you have a signal.

voice.lockRetry.text: Saving your rough draft… trying again.

voice.lockedNote.text: A rough draft stays exactly as you wrote it, typos and all, so it keeps showing how you really write. To fix or reshape it, polish a copy.

voice.lockedTimeUp.text: Time ran out, so it was saved as it was.

voice.madePost.text: Made a draft post. It isn't published.

voice.madePostUndone.text: The draft post is gone. Your piece didn't change.

voice.makePostHelp.text: Makes a draft post from your saved polished copy. It isn't published until you publish it.

voice.makePostSaveFirst.text: Save your polished copy first. The post is made from the saved copy.

voice.moved.text: Moved to {where}. Copied byte for byte.

voice.noSignal.text: That needs a signal. Your writing is kept on this phone.

voice.noSignalList.text: Your pieces need a signal to show. Anything you were writing is kept on this phone.

voice.notPrivate.text: Your voice writing may not stay private.

voice.nothingYet.text: Nothing's written yet, so there's nothing to save. Write something, or start over.

voice.openActive.text: You started “{title}” somewhere else and the clock is still running.

voice.openExpired.text: You started “{title}” somewhere else and its time ran out.

voice.openHeading.text: You have a piece in progress

voice.otherSetHelp.text: Prompts {product} doesn't offer any more. Your pieces stay readable.

voice.phoneRefused.text: This phone won't keep a copy, so keep this page open until it says Saved.

voice.pieceGone.text: This piece isn't there any more. It may have been moved or erased.

voice.pieceNoRough.text: Its rough draft is missing, so it can't be opened.

voice.pieceThrowBusy.text: That one is still being written somewhere else. Finish it there first.

voice.pieceThrowFailed.text: That didn't work. Nothing was thrown away.

voice.pieceThrowText.text: Its rough draft and any polished copy are taken off {product}'s computer. It can't be brought back. Your voice guide keeps what it learned until you update it.

voice.polishDirty.text: Changes not saved. A copy is kept on this phone.

voice.polishDirtyMemory.text: Changes not saved. Keep this page open until you save.

voice.polishHelp.text: This one is yours to change: fix typos, cut, reshape and give it a title. Your rough draft stays as it is.

voice.polishInvalid.text: That couldn't be saved. Check the title has no line breaks.

voice.polishNew.text: Not saved yet. It starts as a copy of your rough draft.

voice.polishResetDone.text: Your rough draft is back in the copy. Not saved yet.

voice.polishSavedTyping.text: Saved. What you typed while it saved isn't saved yet.

voice.polishTooLong.text: That's longer than a piece can hold. Shorten it a little before saving.

voice.postTaken.text: A post with this name already exists. Change the title of your polished copy, save, and try again.

voice.restoreText.text: Changes you didn't save are kept on this phone.

voice.restoreTextChanged.text: Changes you didn't save are kept on this phone. The copy was changed somewhere else since, so saving will ask which to keep.

voice.restoredCopy.text: Your latest words were on this phone. They're back.

voice.roughHelp.text: Spelling and autocorrect are off here on purpose, so it shows how you really write.

voice.roughRegion.text: Your rough draft, as you wrote it

voice.roughTooLong.text: That's more than a piece can hold. What's here is saved.

voice.serverTrouble.text: {product} couldn't do that just now. Your writing is kept on this phone.

voice.sessionFile.text: The piece in progress is kept in {path} until it is saved.

voice.sessionMoved.text: This piece was finished somewhere else.

voice.sessionStuck.text: A piece in progress can't be read.

voice.signIn.text: Sign in again to keep going. Your writing is kept on this phone.

voice.signOutAsk.text: Sign out and throw away your unsaved writing?

voice.signOutText.text: Changes to your writing voice are kept only on this phone.

voice.startOverText.text: What you've written in this piece is thrown away.

voice.startRefused.text: That prompt can't be used. Choose another.

write.collectionHelp.text: Put it with others, like all your posts on one topic.

write.storyNudgeHeading.text: Want your helper to sound like you?

write.storyNudgeLaterDone.text: Okay. It's under Getting started whenever you want it.

write.storyNudgeStopped.text: Okay, it won't ask again. Getting started is in the menu if you change your mind.

write.storyNudgeText.text: Tell it a few short stories, typed or out loud. It learns how you talk and write, so its suggestions sound like you, not like a computer. It takes about ten minutes, and the stories never appear on {product}.

yours.cantPublish.text: The next update can't publish this. Open it to see why.

yours.checksNone.text: The research checks found nothing for this post. Checks can't see everything.

yours.checksNot.text: Research checks run on research posts and posts that cite.

yours.convertText.text: It stops being private there: readers see it once you publish.

yours.convertTitle.text: Put this note in your post as your own words?

yours.converted.text: Your note is in your post as your own words.

yours.interpretationNever.text: An interpretation is never cited or put in a post. Readers see it only inside aligned passages you publish.

yours.lede.text: Only what you put in goes into this post. Quotations go in with their citation; your notes go in only if you turn one into your own words.

yours.linkComparison.text: Put in a link to these aligned passages

yours.linkDating.text: Put in “{date}” linked to the entry

yours.linkEntry.text: Put in a link to this entry

yours.linkedNotes.text: {count} of your notes are about it. They never go in with it.

yours.noCitation.text: That didn't go in: no citation came back. Your post didn't change.

yours.notApproved.text: Not published: you haven't let readers see this. Nothing private is linked.

yours.noteLine.text: Your own unpublished thinking. It never goes in unless you turn it into your own words.

yours.partFailed.text: Your {what} can't be read, so it isn't offered here. Nothing changed.

yours.quoteHelp.text: The words go in exactly as kept, as a quotation after the paragraph you're in, with its citation. The rights statement is yours; it doesn't mean you may quote them.

yours.refusedBlock.text: That can't go inside code or a part kept as written. Put your cursor in plain words first.

yours.rightsText.text: Quoting them on your blog is your decision.

yours.siteOff.text: Your blog doesn't publish the atlas yet, so a link would lead nowhere. {helper} can turn it on.

yours.siteOffCompare.text: Your blog doesn't publish aligned passages yet, so a link would lead nowhere. {helper} can turn it on.

yours.sourceHelp.text: Only the key and the places you give go into your post.

youtube.chapterHelp.text: Chapters are lines in your words that start with a time, like “0:00 Getting started”. The first starts at 0:00, and YouTube needs at least three, each 10 seconds or longer.

youtube.chapters.text: {count} chapters, from the lines in your words that start with a time.

youtube.copyRefused.text: Select the words and copy them.

youtube.descriptionBrackets.text: YouTube doesn't allow < or > in the description. Take them out of the summary, the chapters or the AI note.

youtube.descriptionCopied.text: Description copied. Paste it into YouTube.

youtube.descriptionTooLong.text: These words are too long for YouTube, which takes 5,000 at most, counting the chapters. Shorten the summary.

youtube.detailsCli.text: Check or write out the full release with `openblog video {slug}`; uploading is in docs/video-production.md §Upload an approved release.

youtube.detailsLocal.text: Worked out on this page with the engine's rules; the server's copy shows when there is a signal.

youtube.durationMissing.text: Add how long the video is, so the last chapter can be checked.

youtube.firstNotZero.text: The first chapter has to start at 0:00.

youtube.keepPrivate.text: Keep the video private on YouTube until this post is on your site.

youtube.lede.text: Paste these into YouTube when you put your video up. Nothing here changes your video.

youtube.noAddress.text: Save your post to add its address.

youtube.noChapters.text: No chapters. That's fine; YouTube shows the video without them.

youtube.oneChapter.text: 1 chapter, from the line in your words that starts with a time.

youtube.other.text: YouTube may not take these words as they are.

youtube.outOfOrder.text: The chapters' times have to go up, one after the other.

youtube.rowProblem.text: Words for YouTube: 1 thing YouTube won't take

youtube.rowProblems.text: Words for YouTube: {count} things YouTube won't take

youtube.rowReady.text: Words for YouTube: ready to copy · {chapters}

youtube.tagsTooLong.text: YouTube takes up to 500 letters of tags; yours have {count}. Use fewer or shorter tags.

youtube.titleBrackets.text: YouTube doesn't allow < or > in a title. Take them out of the title.

youtube.titleMissing.text: Give your post a title first.

youtube.titleTooLong.text: YouTube takes titles of up to 100 letters; this one has {count}. Shorten the title.

youtube.tooFew.text: YouTube shows chapters only when there are at least 3. Add more, or take the times out.

youtube.tooShort.text: Each chapter has to be at least 10 seconds long, the last one too.
